svg.aria-label: The same LC low-pass filter applied to bipolar SPWM with frequency ratios 6, 21 and 100: the output becomes a clean sine only when the carrier is far above the filter corner
svg.text: One LC filter, three carriers: a clean sine needs the carrier far above the corner

text.tspan: Filtered v_o vs. t — the same filter, the carrier ratio decides how clean the sine is
